_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). Powersurge's Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids PwA–PwC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

PwA.name: Datasheet: the film written up as a chip's datasheet, four frames over a part-number bar, a Moore's Law curve with a Linear/Log toggle, a pin table under the network, a revision-history table that opens each version's page, the climax and the signal chain

PwB.name: Curve: a sticky Moore's Law chart whose dot climbs as the film's years scroll past, Blender vs TouchDesigner as a two-column ledger, the four drives as sparkline cards, the climax over a 5:35 runtime bar

PwC.name: Control surface: a preset bank that swaps the big render, version pads that set range bars, a pin-matrix patch of data to parameters, the edit as DAW lanes across 5:35, the climax beside the slider tool

PwB2.name: Curve, refined: PwB with years on the opening frames, steps that say what the film shows, a Linear/Log toggle and 75% knee echoed by the runtime bar, and the drives as a pin matrix

PwD.name: To scale: one row per year whose height follows Moore's Law (model), eighteen hairline years then rows that open up into the film and renders; the build as a code diff beside the version pages; the climax, then the slider tool

PwE.name: Explorable: drag the year inside a sentence and the film frame, film time, size and colour follow; the build as a staircase of book pages with Blender struck off the top rung; the climax, then the slider tool
